text:
nina: Heads-up: Horizons conference joint session with VertexEdge next Friday. Goals: 1) hybrid stage + remote demo handover, 2) contactless locker pickup for co-branded swag, 3) short marketplace announcement slide at t+12m. Need assignments.

ryan: I can take demo handover logic. Is the partner using our streaming SDK or their own?

sophia: VertexEdge will use our SDK v1.4 for the live demo but wants to failover to their runner if network issues occur.

kai: For lockers: we're doing NFC + QR fallback. Vendor says pre-provisioned single-use tokens required. merch-bot, can you confirm token generation capacity?

merch-bot: Token generator can create 5k single-use tokens. ETA for encoded NFC tags: 2026-04-05.

nina: Good. Ryan, can you implement a deterministic leader election: stage presenter has priority, remote runner takes over on video loss or >5s audio desync.

ryan: Will add a simple state machine and a health ping every 2s. Sample event: PRESENTER_HEARTBEAT -> if missing for 5s then promote REMOTE_RUNNER.

sophia: I'll coordinate rehearsals. Two slots: Wed quick tech check (15m) and Fri full run (25m). Also need captions in EN/ES — VertexEdge covers Spanish.

kai: Locker UX: scan NFC -> show short form (name + email) -> choose pickup or ship. We'll default to pickup. If ship chosen, collect address then mark token used. I'll ask vendor about hashed pickup tokens.

merch-bot: Vendor confirms hashed pickup tokens ok. Shipping cutoff NA: 2026-03-29. EU courier: 2026-03-25.

nina: Marketplace announcement copy needs embargo timing. Sophia, can marketing review by EOD tomorrow?

sophia: Yes. I'll post draft to #marketing and tag legal for embargo clearance.

ryan: I'll also prepare a prerecorded fallback video (exact same SDK run) and host it on our CDN. If failover occurs, switch stream to CDN clip and update captions feed.

kai: Onsite ops: can the venue hold 30 emergency swag items in Green Room? ops-bot?

ops-bot: Confirmed. 30 items held, Green Room shelf C.

nina: Final owners: Ryan (demo handover + fallback), Kai (locker flow + vendor), Sophia (rehearsals + announcement copy), Merch-bot/Ops-bot (fulfillment and onsite hold). Rehearsal invites by EOD.

sophia: Added run-of-show draft: 0-2m intro, 2-12m announcement, 12-32m demo, 32-42m q&a, 42-45m close. Link: https://redwood-internal.link/horizons-runsheet

nina: Perfect. Ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
